name: @mercatus-liber/storefront-views
description: Storefront views (storefront-views-and-multi-catalog epic): a named, curated presentation layer over ONE store's already-real catalog -- a category subset, its own hero copy, an optional theme override -- addressable at its own route without duplicating catalog/cart/checkout/PDP/PLP logic. Depends on @mercatus-liber/core only, referencing categoryIds/demoSlug by bare string ids, the same structural-dependency posture as @mercatus-liber/promotions/recommendations/reviews. Three real patterns this makes possible with the SAME mechanism: (1) a permanent second storefront over a shared catalog (a 'parts counter' split, or two differently-curated storefronts over one inventory); (2) a time-boxed campaign takeover (getActiveDefaultOverride considers real startsAt/endsAt against the current time, so a seasonal microsite becomes the store's default home page for its real window and automatically reverts after -- no manual revert action needed); (3) multiple fully separate brands/catalogs is already what this repo's own multi-demo routing provides (each demo store is its own isolated catalog instance) and needs no new code here.
